emergence.summary: Loss-of-function of lysosomal alpha-galactosidase A (GLA) lowers the catabolism of globotriaosylceramide (Gb3/GL-3), so the glycosphingolipid substrate accumulates in vascular endothelium, kidney, heart and nerve. The throughput axis is driven DOWN; correction is to restore enzymatic throughput (replace the enzyme / stabilise residual amenable enzyme) or to lower the substrate load upstream. X-linked; a lysosomal-storage read on the same level axis as Gaucher and A1AT.

per_gene.note: lysosomal alpha-galactosidase A; LOF lowers Gb3/GL-3 catabolism -> glycosphingolipid accumulates (vascular endothelium, podocytes, cardiomyocytes). X-linked (Xq22.1). NCBI official symbol GLA. Coding/splice lesions (missense e.g. Gly328Arg, the IVS4+919 cardiac-variant); promoter firewall respected.
